Nicolas: Or vapes into smoking
Nicolas: Or cigarettes into smoking

Vanessa: Good*

Vanessa: Oh dang then i probably have been doing it wrong lol
Nicolas: I like it with lots of lemons [IMAGE: there is a cup of tea with lemon slices in it]

Nicolas: I got a hypothetical question for ya

Vanessa: Like deli, supermarket, etc?
Nicolas: Lets say a walmart or a target
Nicolas: Your choice of one of the two

Nicolas: What would you do for entertainment though?

Nicolas: Like what?

Vanessa: Like video games and different games for it
Nicolas: The only thing I can think of are those free trial games they have in the store
Nicolas: Hmm thats fair
Nicolas: Ok what if its the same terms but people are shopping as usual
Nicolas: How long would you last then
Vanessa: Im not sure since i dont like being around people lol so maybe a couple of days before i give up
Nicolas: Hmmm
Nicolas: What about 8 hours a day like a normal job
Nicolas: Then you get to go back home after your shifts up
Vanessa: Ooo then i can probably do that ok
Vanessa: Since not staying in the store overnight
Nicolas: For how long thougj
Nicolas: I feel like if i got bored id pretend to be a target employee or something
Nicolas: See how long I can keep it up without being exposed
Vanessa: Not that long just because of that reason lol
Nicolas: How much would it take for you to stay as long as possible
Nicolas: 10k a day?
Vanessa: Still same answer as before not too long for me
Nicolas: Fair enough
Vanessa: Yeah since not really much of a difference
Nicolas: Whatchya up to right now?
Vanessa: Still at work but still not that busy so maybe we can head out early today
Nicolas: Nice gotta love leavin early
Vanessa: Seriously since id rather be home than be bored at work with not much to do
Vanessa: Do you have any plans for the rest of the day?
Nicolas: Hmm im tempted to go out to the local park
Nicolas: Its dark out right now but im tempted cause the vibes at night are nice
Nicolas: Quiet and less noise pollution
Vanessa: If you have a dog itll be nice to have a walk outside
Nicolas: Hmm maybe if the park was close
Nicolas: It sounds nice
Vanessa: Do you have a dog?
Nicolas: I wish I did
Nicolas: They seem fun to have
Nicolas: Do you?
Vanessa: Same, i feel like having a dog would be fun too since they appear to be energetic and up to doing anything
Nicolas: What kinda dog would you like?
Nicolas: Breed wise
Vanessa: Maybe a bernese mountain dog
Vanessa: I always heard theyre very gentle giant breeds
Nicolas: I forget what breed name it is but I like long nose dogs
Nicolas: Preferrably one that wont shed
Vanessa: I think maybe a Borzoi? Ive heard those dogs have freakishly long snouts
Nicolas: Yeah that one
Nicolas: I dunno why but i just wanna grab their snout

Nicolas: Probably lol
Nicolas: Its fun to do it though
Vanessa: Anything interesting youve been watching recently?
Nicolas: Ive been watching the Great British Bakeoff
Nicolas: I love watching cooking shows
Nicolas: Like i love gordon ramsay
Nicolas: He's my idol

Vanessa: What got you blocked?
Nicolas: I dont know thats the issue
Nicolas: Maybe it was an accident
Nicolas: It makes me sad to think about it sometimes
Nicolas: So im out taking an evening stroll to clear my head [IMAGE: cars parked on the side of the road at night]
Vanessa: I believe it since hes your idol so it must hurt being blocked 😞
Vanessa: I have an older brother that also got blocked by gordon ramsay
Vanessa: He seems down about it too
Vanessa: But i hope the walk is helping!
Nicolas: Its ok if he doesnt need me i dont need him

Vanessa: You are your own independent king/queen
Nicolas: Thanks for the help
Nicolas: If your brother got blocked too it mustve been a mistake
Nicolas: Idk why he would block multiple ppl though
Vanessa: Maybe hes trying to limit how many fans he has since he has so many
Nicolas: I hope so
Vanessa: One day he would look back and unblock people is what im hoping for
Vanessa: I believe something good will happen
Nicolas: This is gonna be my villain arc
Nicolas: Im gonna aim to be an amazing chef to work at Gordons restaurants
Nicolas: Then when he sees me I will tell him he is the reason I became a chef but not for a good reason
Nicolas: I became a chef to prove him wrong

Vanessa: Once you put your heart into it, itll be possible
That'll show him!

Nicolas: Paycheck to paycheck

Nicolas: Whatre you up to?
Vanessa: Watching a show right now about some mom with munchausen syndrome while eating apples with peanut butter [IMAGE: there are many apples and limes in a basket on the table]
Vanessa: I have granny smith apples since theyre just in the house but i wish it was Macintosh apples
Nicolas: Yum i love apples
Vanessa: Im going to start my routine for bed soon 😅 any routines you like to do before sleeping?

Nicolas: Alright seeya tomorrow!
Vanessa: Have a good night!

Nicolas: Good morning tho
